invariants.rationale: The method returns a BulkInsertPartitioner instance, which is always a new object or obtained from a factory method, so result will not be null.
strategyParams is used in method body without null check, implying it cannot be null at this point.
schema is used in HoodieSchemaUtils.addMetadataFields without a null check, suggesting it must not be null before return.
If strategyParams contains the relevant key, the method returns a JavaCustomColumnsSortPartitioner, otherwise not.
Whenever the key is missing, the result is a BulkInsertPartitioner returned from the factory; but all returned objects technically implement BulkInsertPartitioner.
